notes: Curated superarchetype overrides. Curated entries WIN BY KEY over the derived clustering:
a cluster listed here owns its id and label outright, and every archetype it names is pulled
out of whatever derived cluster held it, stamped provenance=curated, and annotated with the
Empty by default. The derived pass is deliberately conservative (a branch must clear a
multiscale-bootstrap AU p-value AND a raw bootstrap-probability floor), so it declines to
assert families it cannot support rather than asserting them wrongly. Add an entry here when
dogfooding shows a real strategy family the AU cut refuses -- that is what this layer is for.
Ids are stable across refreshes and are what downstream surfaces key on: never renumber one.
An archetype may appear in at most one cluster; the loader fails fast on a duplicate.
